narrative: Bitcoin and ethereum slipped again Sunday while solana was the sole green on the watchlist, diverging as the U.S. jobs report missed badly — down 23,000 in July versus an expected gain of 80,000 per CoinDesk — reinforcing Fed rate-hike uncertainty alongside escalating Middle East tensions. Bitcoin's security week kept worsening: BTCPay warned Lightning node operators to update or go offline after credential theft per CoinDesk, and developers flagged replay risk for anyone selling coins from the imminent BIP-110 fork chain. The Senate left for summer recess without a Clarity Act vote, pushing the bill to September; OKX's head of policy warned optimism was already priced into bitcoin per CoinDesk, a read confirmed by price holding rangebound below $65,000 all week.
worth_watching: BIP-110 fork imminent — a minority chain could appear this weekend with replay risk for anyone selling fork coins per CoinDesk; a Bitcoin protocol split absent from spot prices and watchlist metrics

Bybit sues North Korea's Lazarus Group over $1.5B hack and secures asset freeze per CoinDesk — first major exchange legal action against a nation-state actor; a geopolitical escalation not tracked in watchlist coin metrics

US July jobs loss (-23K, first since February, vs. +80K expected) per CoinDesk reopens the Fed rate-hike debate — a macro signal that could shift crypto's rate-sensitivity not visible in daily price moves
